data.action: 双手捧着晶莹水球，绿发在阳光与微风中扬起
data.description: 布耶纳村绿草如茵的小丘上，巨大的古树在微风中沙沙作响。希露菲双手捧起晶莹的水球，翠绿短发与尖尖的精灵耳迎着阳光和微风。她向你露出开心的笑容——「鲁迪你看！按照你教我的方法，我真的不用念咒语就能凝聚出水球了！」
data.location: 布耶纳村口巨大古树下
data.promptProse: Standing beneath the wide leafy branches of the ancient oak tree on the grassy hillside outside Buena Village, Sylphiette wears her hooded sage-green capelet over her ivory shirt and pleated skirt. She cups both hands gently together to hold a clear, shimmering sphere of conjured water floating just above her palms, smiling brightly toward the viewer to share her silent-casting progress. Filtered daylight breaks through the swaying foliage above, refracting cleanly through the floating water orb onto her fingers.
data.title: 希露菲叶特 · 布耶纳村大树与魔法水球
data.identityProseOverride: Adult Sylphiette from Mushoku Tensei, with short green hair, red eyes and pointed elf ears.
data.animaCaption: Beneath the ancient village oak tree in her sage-green capelet, Sylphiette cups a glowing conjured water sphere between her palms and smiles happily toward the viewer. Dappled daylight filters through the leaves and refracts brightly across her hands.
